evidence.why: Raw uploaded SVG content is written unsanitised (no DOMPurify/sanitize-html) into public/uploads/avatars.
File is served from public/ (app origin) via Next.js static serving, which will respond with Content-Type image/svg+xml, allowing stored XSS when the SVG containing <script> is loaded in-browser.

other_classes_observed: path.extname(originalName) used without further sanitising extension
